input.prompt: Using the reference image as the exact layout template: replace the placeholder heading text '[ Your Heading Goes Here ]' with the plain text Where AI Agents Pay Back Fastest (no square brackets, no '[' or ']' characters) in the same magenta color, same bold font style, same size and position between the two vertical accent bars. Replace the placeholder line '[ Optional subheading or supporting line goes here ]' with the plain text Months to payback, by business function (2026 data), completely remove the square bracket characters, they must not appear anywhere in the subheading, in the same gray color and size. Keep the 'EVOLVEX · INSIGHT' label, the light pink background, the evolvextechnologies.com footer text, and the evolvex logo in the bottom-right corner exactly as shown, do not alter, move, or duplicate them. Fill the large empty content panel in the middle with a clean premium infographic on a soft light mauve background: a ranked horizontal bar chart with four rows stacked vertically, shortest bar on top growing to longest at the bottom. Each row has a small hexagonal icon on the left with a dark plum interior and thin pink and purple glowing border containing a simple white line icon, then a bold dark plum label, then a rounded horizontal bar filled with a pink-to-orange gradient whose length is proportional to the number, with the bold orange number at the right end of the bar. Row 1: 'Sales Outreach' (megaphone icon), bar about 30% of the available width, '3.4 months'. Row 2: 'Customer Service' (headset icon), bar about 42% width, '4.7 months'. Row 3: 'Finance & Operations' (calculator icon), bar about 78% width, '8.9 months'. Row 4: 'Legal & Compliance' (balance scales icon), bar about 98% width, '11.2 months'. Below the chart, a thin horizontal pink-to-orange gradient divider line, then a single bold statistic callout centered: large bold orange text '2.7x' with a short gray caption beneath 'more likely to reach production with one named owner'. Accents: orange #F1600A, magenta #EE2A7B, purple #6228D7, sparing gold #F9CE34. All text must be sharp, correctly spelled, and legible.
input.negative_prompt: placeholder text, square bracket characters, literal '[' character, literal ']' character, bracketed text, 'Your Heading Goes Here', 'Optional subheading', misspelled words, blurry text, dark overall background, teal tones, blue tones, added logos, added wordmarks, altering the footer, altering the logo, clutter, overlapping text, bars of equal length, wrong numbers
